payload.description: Whether the savings the council promises each February are actually made by the following March. The council publishes the savings it has identified when it sets the budget — £3.2m for 2025/26, £3.1m for 2024/25 — but no outturn report or set of accounts we have read tracks delivery against them as a single figure. This is the most obvious accountability question about a council's money, and it cannot be answered from Norwich's published papers. It is a fair question for a resident to put to the council directly.
